item.tib: stag lha phung 'bar nag po'i skong ba dun rtse stong sgrol
item.coloph: bdag 'dra phung bon mgo dmar gyis/ 'ol mo rung ring gsang phug tu/ ston pa stag la me 'bar la/ lha nor bcu gsum phul nas zhus/ dka' ba du ma spyad nas zhus/ smon lam btab nas dran pa nyid la gtad/ khod spungs dran pa bdag gis kyang / rma gnyen pom ra'i rtse la sbas/ brag seng ge 'dra ba'i 'og me long 'dra ba'i gong / brag shel gur phub pa 'dra ba'i dkyil du sbas so/ dun rtse'i lag tu mi 'gro bar rgyas btab nas/ bde 'gro srid pa'i rgyal mo dang / mdo gam lha btsan gnyis kyis thub par srung / kyu ra'i gter ma'o//
